Sweet Summer Dreams (Korean: 여름방학의 단꿈, yeoreumbanghag-eul dankkum, "Sweet Dreams of Summer Vacation") is Blue Whale Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying her in the second half of The Lost City's New Future update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Summer vacation is as much for the teachers as it is for the little ones! Blue Whale Cookie's closed the Nursery for a few days to take a well-deserved vacation to the beach, where she sunbathes, reads, and swims to her heart's content... While part of her wishes this vacation could continue forever, her eyes can't help but be drawn to the young Cookies playing and enjoying their own vacation at the seaside.

Trivia

  • Sweet Summer Dreams was released alongside  First Summer Vacation.
  • Sweet Summer Dreams's Gacha Illustration is shown from  Endless Summer Fun's perspective.
